newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico issues more public telephone permits.
newsitem.headline: Mexico issues more public telephone permits.

text.p: The Mexican government said on Tuesday it had issued two more permits to private firms to provide public telephone services, bringing to six the permits issued so far.
The Communications and Transport Ministry said the permits were issued to the firms Cid Comunicaciones SA de CV and World Center of Video Conferences SA de CV.

The two firms had agreed with the government to install 3,300 phones in north and central Mexico and 7,940 in Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey, investing a total of 132 million pesos over the next five years, it said.
The government expected to issue seven more permits in the coming days, it added.
